PHASE.NAME: External Release Evidence and Adoption Feedback
PHASE.GOAL: Collect real Linux/macOS release evidence and convert user feedback into support and installer hardening

PLANNED_WORK.step-1: Validate diagnostics against fresh Linux/macOS machines and convert repeated failures into installer guidance.
PLANNED_WORK.step-2: Keep release-candidate evidence auditable across hosted CI and manual release workflows.
PLANNED_WORK.step-3: Expand parity gates only when new public support or onboarding claims are added.

ACCEPTANCE.CHECK: Fresh Linux/macOS install evidence is captured before the next public release
Support docs reflect observed installer failures without claiming unsupported platforms
Release evidence remains reproducible through CI and release-candidate workflows
